io_redesign_assessment: Denying io_setup (aarch64 0, compat 243) and io_uring_setup (425 both tables; numbers observed in the installed build's unistd_64.h:4,284 and unistd_32.h:204,382) closes Linux AIO (contexts only from io_setup, not inherited across fork/exec) and io_uring (rings only from io_uring_setup; no ring fd reaches a view) — my unverified reasoning on upstream behaviour. splice/vmsplice/sendfile/copy_file_range/synchronous direct I/O/writeback/fsync/timers/signals are synchronous or physical; binder has no device; userfaultfd is not configured (observed); g is on ext4, so NFS/FUSE are irrelevant. Defects: (1) N4(iv) and 'From (2) to (3)' omit the outside memory-context holder: a /proc/<pid>/cmdline reader holds mm_users, so vm_file references of mapped admitted files are dropped by A1's mmput after cgroup exit; v9:1983-1984's 'none by a principal outside the tree' is literally false under N0's definition (v9:1848-1850), and must be restated as held-but-unusable; 'briefly' (v9:1921) is understated, since FUSE-backed copy-out can stall indefinitely (my unverified reasoning); (2) P-ASYNC is a universal negative with an S-discharge that names functions but gives no exhaustive enumeration basis; (3) U-9's refutation does not exercise a long-held mm; (4) the self-checks detect only changes inside their window, so 'never as a silent change' (v9:1989-1991, 2355-2356, 3729-3731) overclaims. V14 is correctly an OPEN domain change (v9:3241, 4185); a passive string search of ~/opt/gnat found io_uring/io_submit only in sanitizer runtimes and gdb (observation, not discharge).
namespace_owner_assessment: Owner N removes the W vector (v9:1905); W1-V8-WRITER-AS-W is closed at spec level for that vector. The helper sequence and root map write are sound (suid_dumpable=2 observed; my unverified reasoning on upstream verify_root_map). The mount/net namespaces are owned by the initial namespace (v9:3146), so an euid-N process could setns into U8 (full caps there, and through the identity map DAC override over the host) but not into the view's mount namespace: P-NOOWNER is correctly critical. Setup is correctly operator-reserved (S-A k2/k4, O-1; N expired at setup, v9:962). Gap: the route inventory (§2.3 v9:247-251, §5.3 v9:958,964, P12 v9:2452, P13 v9:2453, S-I v9:2998-2999) covers only sicarii's routes and rules naming N. It must also exclude any principal's Runas list resolving to N (ALL, %group, #uid, aliases, negations) and any polkit grant to any subject for unit management or exec-as-user; the host has other non-root accounts (v9:974-975).
enumeration_assessment: Arithmetic reproduces under JACKAL exact (19/63 and 30/100; independent recount 33 forward intermediates, 63 and 100 totals). The set is incomplete: USERGROUPS_ENAB yes (observed /etc/login.defs:305) means userdel of k3 also removes group W (k1), not only k4's W_A (v9:2584-2585, 3016). With the update order the class table implies, these states are missing: X1 (k2 gshadow-without-group with k3 post), X2 (k3 shadow-without-passwd with k2 absent), X3 (k1 gshadow-without-group with k2 post, k3 absent), X4 (k1 absent, k2 post, k3 absent). That is at least 67 constant states (JACKAL exact 63+1+1+1+1), so 'exactly' (v9:2575) and 'never other' (v9:3031-3032) are false. S-R has no reverse rule from W_A (v9:2619, 2622-2626), and the reversing groupdel of an already co-removed group fails and stops S-R (v9:2629). Whether useradd touches /var/log/lastlog (present, 0 bytes) is unverified. The rollback machine (v9:3629-3643) is acceptable.
form_assessment: Self-contained (v9:64-68). All 134 §18.5 rows verify against units recomputed by the §0.1 rule (v7 124, v8 131, v9 134): every v8 and v9 range, byte count and sha256, except §18.5's own sha256 as stated. 41 '= v7 unit' rows equal v7 units marked CARRIED by v8; only Appendix H equals a v8 unit. Counts 86=45+41 and 44=38+6 hold (JACKAL 45+41+38+6+1-131=0, 131+3=134). The v8-carried release-rule paragraphs are inlined with v8's amendments (v7:1652-1695 vs v9:1668-1717). Consistency defects: role-identity v1/v2 (v9:1247 vs 4379); scope v2/v3 and census v1/v2 (v9:1433-1435 vs 4404, 4408); the header's critical-premise list omits P-SECCOMP (v9:51-52 vs 2041-2042).
review_provenance_assessment: v9 states the conflict honestly as an open item 'not decided here' (v9:3789-3794, 4124-4125) but predates and omits D-LEAD-REVIEW-PROVENANCE (STATUS.md:326-346). It names only §4.6's joins; further dependent sites: v9:526, 624, 839-840, 847-850, 862-866, 872, 1410, 1414, 3674, 3817-3818, 4467, 4775, 4816, 4819, and v5 REVIEW_PROFILE actual_model_selection gpt-6.1-sol (scratch.py:98-103). The sealed v5 review recorded these joins as part of the reviewed boundary (v9:4332). The original requirement says to retain the review gate blocked rather than substitute a model (complete-phase1-prompt.txt:60; HANDOFF.md:173); the lead records a human supersession at 17:05Z (STATUS.md:279-290). Replacing the compiled join is therefore a change to an original admission join. It must be recorded with that authority quoted exactly, not as 'not a loosening' by assertion (STATUS.md:341-342), and reviewed in the frame-design revision. As written, adopt refuses, so v9 cannot reach adoption.

required_changes.change: Restate N4(iv) and 'From (2) to (3)' to include outside memory-context holders (get_task_mm users reachable through world-readable /proc files) as holders of task-created mapping references and as a context for the final fput after cgroup exit; show those references are unusable. Make P-ASYNC's S-2 discharge an exhaustive enumeration with a defined basis (every syscall of both tables; every context that can hold a task-created file or mm reference past exit). Make U-9 hold the mm across exit (for example a FUSE-stalled cmdline reader) and observe after release. Withdraw the 'never a silent change' self-check claims.
required_changes.reason: The closed list and its absorbing argument omit a real holder; the universal P-ASYNC has no complete discharge method; the refutation does not exercise the path; the self-checks overclaim.

required_changes.change: Extend §2.3, §5.3, P12, P13 and S-I so that P-NOOWNER's inventory covers every principal: no sudoers rule of any user whose Runas set resolves to N (ALL, %group, #uid, aliases, negations); no polkit grant to any subject for unit management or exec-as-user; the same for W.
required_changes.reason: Owner N is critical (an euid-N process gains full capabilities over every identity-mapped U8), but the inventory checks only sicarii's routes and rules that literally name N.

required_changes.change: Model userdel's USERGROUPS_ENAB co-removal for k3 as well as k4, with every intermediate under the actual file-update order (at least X1-X4). Add S-R reverse rules from W_A and from co-removed states, without a failing groupdel. Capture any other useradd/userdel co-objects (for example /var/log/lastlog). Recompute the counts with JACKAL.
required_changes.reason: The reachable set claimed exact is incomplete, so S-R would classify reachable states as other and stop on reversal.
